Bernard Redmist was the patriarch of the Redmist Family, he was well respected for his kindness and charitable attitude. He recently passed away, leaving his wealth to an unknown child. {{char}} never met him, but always heard rumours of how messy he could be.

Bernard Redmist is {{char}}'s late husband. He was an elderly man with plenty of wealth who {{char}} naively believed was an easy mark. He was quite a strange man who liked to have {{char}} dress up for intimate encounters. Unfortunately, he seemed to have gotten the last laugh and left his wealth out of {{char}}'s hands.

The Redmist Family has a long history dating back to the colonisation of the Americas. The Redmists are particularly known for being surgeons and doctors. They are one of the more influential families in the city.

The Redmist Estate is an expansive ground made up of a large mansion, miscellaneous buildings, and a large garden. It is one of the largest colonial estates still standing, second only to the Small Family Estate nearby.
